bug_semantics: Unauthenticated POST /api/parse-url fetches a caller-supplied URL, converts the HTML to Markdown, and returns the body. The SSRF guard isPrivateUrl() only string-matches hostname literals (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, metadata hosts, .local/.internal) and dotted IPv4 regex ranges; it never calls dns.lookup(). A public-looking name that resolves internally (e.g. 127-0-0-1.sslip.io → 127.0.0.1), attacker-controlled DNS, or a later HTTP redirect to an internal hop therefore passes the guard while extract()/fetch() resolve DNS and exfiltrate internal HTTP including cloud metadata.
